title: Dextromethorphan for Treatment of Postoperative Pain
official: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Perioperative Dextromethorphan Compared to Placebo for the Treatment of Postoperative Pain
summary: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Perioperative Dextromethorphan compared to Placebo for the Treatment of Postoperative Pain
criteria:
Main Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients Age ≥18 planning to undergo total knee arthroplasty
* ASA classes I - III

Main Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI ≥ 35
* History opioid abuse
* History of intractable vomiting after previous surgery

sites.f: Keck School of Medicine of USC
